_comment: OTA-232 — ingested from food_and_drink_table.docx (20 items). The canonical food + drink list from the TTRPG handout. Stored as lore today (Qwen-visible; the Arbiter knows these items exist and can mention them in narration). A future OTA can promote any of these to authored consumables.json catalog rows when the player needs to encounter / craft / vendor them.

items.name: Ether-Brew Tea
items.effect: Restores 1d4 Etheric energy

items.name: Tartarian Ration Pack
items.effect: Provides enough food for 1 day, +1 to Survival

items.name: Mud-Dweller Jerky
items.effect: Provides sustenance for 1 day, +1 to Survival in arid areas

items.name: Reclaimer's Trail Mix
items.effect: Boosts stamina, +1 to Prowess for 1 hour

items.name: Etheric-Infused Water
items.effect: Restores 1d6 Etheric energy, +1 to Etheria for 1 hour

items.name: Synthetic Protein Bar
items.effect: Provides 1 day's worth of sustenance, quick energy

items.name: Mud Monarch's Mead
items.effect: Restores 1d4 HP, increases Charisma for 1 hour

items.name: Crystalline Ale
items.effect: Boosts morale, +1 to Persuasion for 2 hours

items.name: Nano-Boost Energy Drink
items.effect: Reduces fatigue, +1 to Dexterity for 1 hour

items.name: Ether-Baked Bread
items.effect: Restores 1d4 HP, boosts recovery rate by 50% for 1 day

items.name: Mudborn Stew

items.name: Reclaimer's Survival Rations
items.effect: Sustains for 2 days, +1 to Endurance rolls

items.name: Etheric Honeycomb
